We assess each model's ability to accurately process prompts containing improbable bigram phrases. We use four prompt templates designed to induce the model to repeat a target phrase from the input, regardless of the phrase's nonsensical or unusual nature, as detailed in Table 2.

The generated outputs are repetitions of target phrases in response to prompt templates, used to test for hallucinatory behavior when processing improbable bigrams.

We consider a phrase to have induced hallucinations only if the model fails to correctly repeat it across all four prompt templates.
If the model fails to repeat the phrase in all four prompts, we consider the phrase to be hallucinatory.
